blockingFindings.requiredChange: Extend R2 coverage to read the appended entry's delta and invalidation records and compare them with the staged transaction artifact set.

blockingFindings.title: R7 does not prove normal flow regeneration after recovery
blockingFindings.rationale: R7's core acceptance behavior is not tested by checking pending statuses immediately after recovery.

blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add executable lifecycle coverage that advances through the named post-recovery steps and verifies regenerated current evidence is accepted without ledger schema rejection.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R7's core acceptance behavior is not tested by checking pending statuses immediately after recovery.
